newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway expands T-bill by 12 billion crowns.
newsitem.headline: Norway expands T-bill by 12 billion crowns.

text.p: Norway's central bank said on Friday the Finance Ministry was expanding the SS42 treasury bill by 12 billion crowns.
The amount will be issued at an ad hoc auction with final date for tenders at 0900 GMT on Wednesday. Settlement is two days later.
The bill was issued on March 14 1996 with a nominal interest rate of 4.70 percent. It matures on March 19 1997.
The bank does not provide figures for the total amount of money issued in the bill, which was last expanded by 12 billion crowns on January 2.
The bank also said another ad hoc auction would be announced on Thursday next week. It did not say which T-bill would be expanded.
